named-query.name: Restaurant.existsResponsible
named-query.query: select case when count(1) > 0 then true else false end from Restaurant rest join rest.responsibleUsers resp where rest.id = :restaurantId and resp.id = :userId

named-query.name: Order.isOrderManagedBy
named-query.query: select case when count(1) > 0 then true else false end from Order order join order.restaurant rest join rest.responsibleUsers resp where order.id = :orderId and resp.id = :userId
